name: jobwatch
description: Your Hugging Face Jobs in the VS Code status bar: what is running, what it has cost so far, and an alert when a job fails, runs out of memory, nears its timeout or sits in the queue.

jobwatch.monthlyBudgetUsd.markdownDescription: Warn once a month when estimated spend this calendar month passes this many US dollars. `0` turns the budget off.

jobwatch.notifyOnComplete.markdownDescription: Show a notification when a job completes, with its duration and estimated cost. Failures always notify.

jobwatch.timeoutWarningMinutes.markdownDescription: Warn when a running job is this many minutes from its own timeout, before it is killed. `0` turns it off.

jobwatch.queueWarningMinutes.markdownDescription: Warn when a job has waited this many minutes for hardware without starting. `0` turns it off.

jobwatch.pollSecondsActive.markdownDescription: Seconds between refreshes while a job is queued or running.

jobwatch.pollSecondsIdle.markdownDescription: Seconds between refreshes when nothing is queued or running.

jobwatch.namespace.markdownDescription: The user or organisation whose jobs to watch. Empty means the account the Hugging Face token belongs to.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
